chinese.text: 你看见什么了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 一座漂亮的林子。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我还可以把那些伤口包扎起来，免得它们这样张开着，把血流尽，直至死亡。我得做出选择，结束他们的争斗。决不能让这样两个英俊的青年为我而死，决不能让他们哭泣的母亲跟着她们儿子冰凉的遗骸，咒骂我的残忍。天哪，阿奇特有多么温柔的一张脸！聪明的大自然拥有最优秀的天资，所有那些美质都由她播进了贵人们的血统之中，如果她到人间成为一个普通女子，即使带有少女们娇羞的矜持，她无疑也会为这个男人而疯狂。这个青年王子有怎样一双眼睛，有怎样热烈的光彩和敏锐的风情啊！爱神本人就坐在这双眼睛里微笑，正是这另一个放荡的甘尼米德使朱庇特欲火中烧，大神才强迫把这个美童抓到天上来，放在他身旁，成为一个灿烂的星座。
他有怎样一副前额，显示怎样宽广的威风啊，拱起来就像大眼睛朱诺的，但要温柔得多，比彼洛普斯的肩膀还要光滑！

声望和荣誉我想正是从这儿，恰像从指向苍穹的海岬，振翅飞翔，向下界众生歌唱神灵和足以与之媲美的人类的爱情和战斗。和他相比，巴拉蒙不过是他的陪衬，一个暗淡的影子而已；他又黑又瘦，目光迟钝，仿佛死了母亲似的；他性情沉静，从不激动，从无活力，像阿奇特的那种轻快的敏捷，他一丝儿也没有。不过，我们认为是错失的这些表现，也许对他倒很合适：纳克索斯是个忧郁的小伙子，可是美若天人。哦，谁能猜透女人的癖性呢？我是个傻子，已经拿不定主意，我无从选择，我那么愚蠢地撒了谎，女人们该打我一顿才是。巴拉蒙，我跪下来请你原谅，你才是唯一的美男子，你这双眼睛，这双美的明灯，指挥着又威胁着爱神，哪个少女胆敢违抗它们呢？这张褐色的男子汉的脸，是何等粗豪、庄重而又撩人啊！哦，爱神，从此时此刻起，只有这一种肤色才称得上肤色。躺在那儿吧，阿奇特，和他相比，你不过是给掉包留下的丑孩子，一个吉卜赛，而他才是贵人呢。我糊涂了，简直忘乎所以。我已不再打算毕生保持童贞；
如果姐夫刚才来问我爱谁，我会说我已为阿奇特而入迷；现在如果姐姐来问我，我却更迷上了巴拉蒙。让两个站在一起：姐夫，现在你来问我——天哪，我不知道！好姐姐，你来问我——我还得想一想！嗜好真是充满孩子气，有两个好看的玩意儿，同样好玩，可分不出高下，只好嚷着两个都要！
怎么回事，先生？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我从你姐夫、高贵的公爵那儿捎信给你，小姐。骑士们到了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是来结束纷争的吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唯愿我先结束了才好！我究竟犯了什么罪过啊，贞洁的黛安娜，现在得让我清白的青春溅上王子们的鲜血？得让我的贞操成为祭坛，得让爱我者的生命在上面成为我的不幸的美貌的牺牲品？须知使母亲们欢悦的儿子们中间，还没有哪两个比他们更伟大、更优秀啊。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 把他们带进来，尽可能快一些，我很想见到他们。
你两个竞争的情人回来了，还带来他们公正的骑士。美丽的姨妹，你现在必须爱他们中间的一个了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我宁愿得到他们两个，一个也不应当为我而过早死亡。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谁见过他们？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我刚才见过。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也见过。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你从哪儿来，先生？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 从骑士们那儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你既然看见他们，就请说说他们怎么样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 遵命，先生，我将如实谈谈我的观感。单从外观来判断，我从没有见过或者读到过，有比他们带来的这六位更其勇敢的骑士了。阿奇特身边的第一位骑士，一看就是一个壮汉，他的相貌告诉人们，他是一位王子，他的肤色近乎深褐而非黝黑；严峻而高贵，表明他勇敢，无畏，藐视任何艰险。目光环扫，显示内心热烈如焚，看起来就像一头怒狮；他的长发披在身后，又黑又亮，宛如乌鸦的翅膀；他的双肩宽阔而强壮，胳膊又粗又长，腰间以精致的佩带挂着一柄剑，眉头一皱，便可用来保证他的意志。我凭良心说，没有比他更好的战士之友。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你把他评述得很好。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我看比巴拉蒙的第一骑士还差得远。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那么，请谈谈他吧，朋友。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我猜他也是个王子，身份也许还更高一些；因为他的外貌具备高官厚爵的一切风致。他比他所说的那位骑士要更魁梧些，不过脸面亲切得多；他的肤色红润，有如成熟的葡萄。他无疑意识到他为何而战
，因此更易于把这个目标视为己有。他脸上露出对于成功的充分自信，当他愤怒起来，浑身却贯穿着稳固的豪勇，指挥他的武器去完成漂亮的战功，却没有一点过激的痕迹。他不知恐惧为何物，从未流露过这种软弱的气质。他一头黄发，又硬又卷，像繁茂的常春藤纠缠在一起，雷霆也拆它不开。他的脸色有如好战处女
的号衣，纯红与白皙相间，因为他还没有长胡子的福气；他那左右顾盼的眼睛里坐着胜利女神，仿佛她就是来表扬他的豪勇的。他的鼻子高耸，是一种高贵的特征；他的红唇，在打完仗之后，正适于小姐们亲吻。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 难道这些人也必须死么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他说起话来，声如号角。他所有轮廓恰如男子所希望——强壮而整洁。他手持千锤百炼的金柄大斧。他的年龄约摸二十五岁。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 还有一个，是个小个子，但性格粗豪，看来跟任何骑士一样杰出。这样的身材让人抱更美好的希望，我还从没见过的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哦，可是那个脸上长雀斑的？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就是他，大人。他们不都是好样儿的么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，他们是不错。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我觉得，他们如此稀罕，品格又好，真是自然界伟大而又精美的艺术品。他的发色较浅，不是女性的金黄，而是近乎红褐的一种男性的颜色；体态壮实而矫健，显示了一个活跃的灵魂；他的双臂十分健壮，坚强的肌腱缓缓隆起，直到佩带肩章处，有如刚现身的孕妇，这说明他爱好劳作，从不在乎武器的重量；他静则不屈不挠，动则有如猛虎。他长着一双灰色眼睛，得胜处往往流露怜悯；还敏于发现战机，一旦抓到手，立即加以利用。他从不害人，但也不让人害他。他是个圆脸，一笑就是一个情人，皱起眉头，就成为士兵。他头戴胜利者的橡叶冠，里面藏着他夫人的表记。他的年龄约摸三十六岁。手上拿着一根镶着银质浮雕的长矛。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他们都是这样吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 都是体面的世家子弟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 现在我真是太想见到他们了。
夫人，你就要看见男子汉战斗了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我希望看到这场战斗，但不是它的起因，我的君主。他们要是为两个王国的王权而战，倒可以称为勇士。可叹爱情竟然会这样暴虐。
哦，软心肠的妹妹，你是怎么想的呢？现在别哭，等他们流出血来再哭吧。小妞儿，一定是这样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的美貌使他们更加坚强。
尊敬的朋友，我把这场比武交给你主持；请下命令，把赛场收拾得适合骑士们的需要。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，先生。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘻，我要去会会他们。我不能等了。关于他们的汇报使我激动不已，非见到他们不可。好朋友，一切按王家气派办理。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 一定办得富丽堂皇。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可怜的妞儿，去哭吧，无论谁打赢了，都会由于你的罪过，丧失一个高贵的表兄弟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她神志不清，随着月亮的圆缺时好时坏，是不是？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她一直处在一种不碍事的失常状态中，睡得很少，全然没有食欲，除了经常喝水，总梦见另一个世界，一个更好的世界；不论她叽叽咕咕，一言半句，讲些什么，总少不了夹着巴拉蒙这个名字，什么事情都拿它来填塞，好像它能解决一切问题。
瞧，她来了，你得观察一下她的行为。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我全忘了；末尾的叠句是“—呐，—呐”，不是伊米莉娅的老师吉拉多，是写不出来的。他真是异想天开，竟以为站着可以走路，因为在另一个世界里，黛多会看见巴拉蒙，那时她就会跟埃涅阿斯吹了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这是些什么胡说啊？可怜可怜！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 成天都是这样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 要行使我给你讲的这种魔法，你得衔一枚银币在舌尖上，要不就过不了河。
那时，你要有机会到升天的灵魂那儿去，可有得好看的了！我们这些伤透了肝
、给爱情砸得粉碎的姑娘们，要是到了那儿，成天无事可做，只好跟着普罗塞派茵去采花。
那时我要给巴拉蒙扎个花球，让他注意我，然后——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她倒疯得挺俏皮的！再观察一下。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确，我告诉你；我们这些升天的灵魂，有时也去玩“绕麦堆”。
唉，另一个地方的灵魂，生活可过得够呛，火烧呀，油煎呀，水煮呀，嘶嘶响呀，哇哇叫呀，喋喋不休呀，咒天骂地呀！哦，他们受的刑罚可真厉害！千万要小心：谁要是发了疯，上了吊，投了水，都得到那儿去，托朱庇特保佑！到了那儿就给扔进一个大锅里，里面煮着铅汁和高利贷者的脂肪，跟一百万个扒手煮在一起，像老煮也煮不烂的腊肉一样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她的脑子真会胡诌！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那些让姑娘们怀孩子的达官贵人们，也都在这里。他们得站在齐肚脐的火堆里，站在齐胸口的冰堆里，什么部位害了人，就用火来烧，什么部位骗了人，就用冰来冻。人们这才觉得，为了这样一点小事，当真会受到非常严厉的惩罚。相信我吧，为了免得受罪，人们宁愿娶一个患麻风的女巫，我向你保证。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她怎么还这样胡思乱想呢！这可不是根深蒂固的疯癫，而是最绵缠、最深沉的忧郁症。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 听那儿一个傲慢的夫人和一个傲慢的城里太太在一块儿嚎哭！要是我把这场面称作好玩，那我真是禽兽不如。一个喊，“这烟啰！”另一个喊，“这火哟！”一个喊，“哦，是我幕后搞的鬼！”然后嚎哭起来，另一个痛骂来求情的人和她的花园房屋。
我要真诚，我的星星，我的命运……

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你认为她怎么样，先生？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我看她是痰迷心窍，我可爱莫能助。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天哪，那该怎么办？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你可知道，在遇见巴拉蒙之前，她爱过什么男人没有？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我曾经十分希望，她会看中这位绅士，我的朋友。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也确实这样想过，还认为自己做了一桩漂亮的买卖，就是拿出我的家产一半，让她和我现而今货真价实地处于平等的地位。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她的眼睛使用过度，干扰了其他感官。它们可能康复、稳定下来，执行其预先规定的功能，但是目前却处于最严重的迷乱状态。这一点你必须做到：把她关在一个不能有所照明、只能漏进一点光线的地方。

再让她的朋友，年轻的先生你，借用巴拉蒙的名字，陪她一起用餐，和她谈恋爱。这样会引起她的注意，因为这正是她的心病所在；若是别的东西插在她的心和眼睛之间，就会使她的疯病产生反常的行为和笑闹。给她唱些青年人的爱情歌曲，就像她说巴拉蒙在监狱里唱过的那些。到她那儿去，要用当令的鲜花打扮起来，还要抹上闻起来令人爽心的混合香水。这一切都与巴拉蒙相协调，因为巴拉蒙就会唱，巴拉蒙就香喷喷，而且十全十美。要求和她一起用餐，为她切肉，为她干杯，而且从头到尾搀和着向她求爱和接受她的爱。打听一下哪些姑娘曾经是她的伴侣和玩友，让她们嘴里挂着巴拉蒙到她那儿去，还带着一些纪念品露面，仿佛暗示是用来向他求爱的。她现在正处于只能以虚幻防治的虚幻之中。这才可能诱导她吃东西，睡觉，才可能使她身上失衡的一切恢复过去的法规。我不知多少次见过这个方案产生效验，这一次就更对它抱有很大希望了。照办的过程中，我还会来复诊的。让我们就这样贯彻下去；早点把病治好，无疑也会使大家心安。

chinese.text: 现在让他们进来，在神灵面前提出他们虔诚的祈祷吧。让庙里燃起圣火，照得通明，让祭坛在神圣的云雾中将腾起的香烟送给我们头上的神明。应做的事情一样也不可忽略。
从事高尚工作的人们要尊敬那些爱护他们的神明。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 先生，他们进来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 英勇豪强的仇敌们，共有王家血统的对手们，你们今天来到这里，是为了熄灭燃烧在你们之间的亲情，现在且把你们的愤怒摆开一小时，在你们的援助者、万物敬畏的神灵的祭坛面前，像鸽子一样弓下你们倔强的身躯。你们的怒火超出了凡人的性质；对你们的援助也是这样。既然神灵在关注你们，那就正大光明地决斗吧。我让你们先去祈祷，并把我的祝愿分配给你们。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿荣誉落在最可钦佩的战士头上！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 沙漏正在往下滴，不到我们中间一个断了气，它是滴不完的。你只能这样来想，如果我身上有什么东西在这件事情上老跟我对着干，例如一只眼睛反对另一只，一只胳膊压着另一只，我就只得把那闹别扭的一只毁掉；表弟，我会这样做的，虽然它是我身体的一部分。那么，从这一点可以推断，我该怎样对待你了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我正努力把你的名字、你往日的情谊、我们的亲戚关系从我的记忆中一齐推出去；而在原地代之以我一心想毁掉的某种东西。那么，让我们扬起风帆，把这些船只开到上天注定我们要去的港口去吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 说得好。在我转身之前，让我拥抱你，表弟。
只怕我们再也不会拥抱了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 告个别吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好，就这样；再见了，表弟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再见，先生。

骑士们，亲人们，情人们，是的，准备为我而牺牲的朋友们，马尔斯的真正崇拜者们！是他的气魄在你们身上排除了恐惧的种子，甚至恐惧的观念，后者被排除得比前者还要远些——请跟我一起去朝见我们自称是他的崇拜者的神灵吧。去向他祈求狮子的心和老虎的气势，是的，还有它们的凶猛，是的，还有它们的速度——我是指前进的速度，至于退却时则希望我们成为蜗牛才好。你们知道，我的锦标必须从血泊中夺取；还须由膂力和高超武功为我戴上花环，它们还将在花环上面缀以群芳之后。
然后，我们再向他、那位将兵营变成灌满人血的水塘的尊神祈祷——请帮助我，请聚精会神地向他礼拜吧。
强大的尊神，你曾以你的威力将绿色海洋变成鲜红；你的降临将由彗星预示，你在广漠战场所造成的蹂躏将由暴露地面的髑髅来宣布，你的呼气吹倒了农神丰收的果实，你以强壮的手臂从蓝天白云处推倒了砖砌的塔楼，这些塔楼既加固了也摧毁了城市的石墙：我是你的学生，你的战鼓最年轻的追随者，今天请以军事技术教导我，使我得以按照你的赞扬高举我的旗帜，并由你命名为今天的主人。伟大的马尔斯，请将表明你的恩惠的信物给我吧。
哦，堕落时代之伟大的矫正者，腐败国度的震撼者，你含糊古老称号之杰出的决定者，你用鲜血医疗生病的地球，你处治人口过剩的世界！我有幸得到你的徽章，并以你的名义勇敢地实现我的计划。——
我们走吧。

chinese.text: 直笛轻奏。伊米莉娅着白衣上，长发披肩，并戴麦穗花环；一白衣女侍发插鲜花，牵其衣裙；另一女侍持香烟缭绕的银鹿形香炉前行；银鹿置于黛安娜祭坛上，诸女侍退立，伊米莉娅燃香；众行屈膝礼，并下跪。

groups.rationale: Exact source spans withheld pending boundary review; no generated replacement.

chinese.text: 哦，神圣、虚幻、冷漠、恒定的女王，欢乐的弃绝者，缄默，沉思，温柔，孤独，白皙如童女，纯洁如飞雪，你不容许你的女骑士们有更多的血液，除了使她们羞赧的那一点，而羞赧正是她们骑士团的袍服：我，你的祭司，正恭顺地跪在你的祭坛面前。哦，请以你从未见过污秽事物的珍贵的绿色眼睛垂顾一下你的童贞修女；哦，神圣的银色的女主人，请以你从未听过粗俗词语、从未允许淫猥声音进入的耳朵垂听一下我的搀和着神圣恐惧的祈求。这是我最后一次的处女礼拜；我已穿上了新娘的礼服，但仍怀着处女的心情。我已被派定了一位丈夫，但不知道他是谁。我得从两个中间挑选一个，并为他的成功祈祷，可我从不善于挑选。我的两只眼睛非要丧失一只不可，可它们是同样的宝贵，哪一只我都不能丧失；那个死去的可是未经判决的啊。因此，最端庄的女王，在这两个候选人中间，请让那最爱我、最有资格为我所爱的一个来摘去我的麦穗花冠吧，否则请允许我保有原来的身份和品质，好继续留在你的团队里。
请看我们掌管潮汐的将军
从她那神圣的祭坛以崇敬的动作举起了什么：倒是一朵玫瑰花！如果这个预兆果真来自女神，这场争斗肯定会把这两位勇敢的骑士都毁掉，而我，一朵纯洁的花，只得独自生长，没有人来采摘了。
玫瑰谢了，树也倒了。哦，女主人，你这是开革了我。我想，我会被人采摘的，但我不知道你自己的意愿：请解释你的奥秘吧。
我希望她高兴，她的预兆是仁慈的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我给你开的这个方子对她有点疗效吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哦，很有疗效；陪伴她的姑娘们说我就是巴拉蒙，她差不多相信了。就在半小时之前，她还微笑着来找我，问我想吃点什么，我什么时候想亲亲她。我告诉她，想马上就亲，于是亲了她两次。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这就好。亲二十次只怕更好，因为主要就靠这个药方来治她的病。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她还告诉我，她今晚要陪我熬夜，她很清楚我什么时候会来劲儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就让她陪吧，你的劲儿来了，就伺候她一个够，马上就去吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她还要我唱歌呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你唱了没有？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 没有。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那太糟糕了。你应当事事迎合她才是。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哎呀，我没有嗓子，先生，她听了不会满意的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哪怕你嚷嚷一通，也没有关系。今后随她求你做什么，你都得答应。她要你陪她睡觉，你也不能拒绝。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那可不行，医生。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这是在给她治病嘛。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对不起，可先得讲点名节呀。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那不过是杞人忧天。切莫为了名节误了孩子。先这样治病要紧；今后要讲名节，她还可以嫁人嘛。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谢谢你，医生。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 请把她带进来，让我们瞧瞧她怎样了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我这就去，还告诉她，她的巴拉蒙在等她；不过，医生，我还是觉得，你这个方子不大妥。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去吧，去吧！你们这些当父亲的都是大傻瓜。她的名节！我们会给她吃药的，等到发现了……

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唷，你认为她不大清白吗，先生？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她好大了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她十八岁。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可能没事，不过反正都一样，对我们的目的没有关系。不管她父亲说什么，如果你觉察到，她的情绪有我说的那么一点意思，就是肉体上的——你懂我的话吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 懂，懂，先生。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就满足她的欲望吧，满足到家才好。就靠这项动作来治好她的病，她所感染的那种忧郁症。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我跟你想到一块去了，医生。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你会发现就是这么回事。她来了，务必迁就她。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 喂，孩子，你的情人巴拉蒙等你咧，他这一小时一直在等着见你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谢谢他有礼貌的耐性，他是个好绅士，我跟他难舍难分。你没见过他给我的马吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 见过了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你欢喜它吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 它很漂亮。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你没见过它跳舞吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 没见过。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我可常见到。它跳得很好，很美。跳起捷格舞
来，不管是跟秃尾马还是长尾马相比，它都把你转得像陀螺。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那真是好。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 它跳摩尔斯，一小时跳二十英里，我要是会猜，那会把全教区的跳马高手
跳断腿，还会按着“爱之光”
的调子飞跑。你看这匹马怎样？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 有这些本领，我看简直可以把它牵来打网球。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哎呀，那算不了什么。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 它还能读书写字吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 写得一手好字，连干草饲料账自己都会算。哪个马夫想虚报账目蒙混他，还得起早床。你知道公爵养的那匹栗色母马吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 非常清楚。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她非常迷恋巴拉蒙给我的这匹马，可怜的牲口，可这匹马像它的主人一样，冷冷淡淡，待理不理。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她可有什么嫁妆呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 大约两百捆干草，二十斛燕麦，可他决不会要她的。他咬着舌头一声长嘶，准能把一匹磨坊母马勾引到手，他会把她搞死的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她讲些什么废话！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 求婚者上前。

groups.rationale: Exact source spans withheld pending boundary review; no generated replacement.

chinese.text: 美人儿，你好？多好的姑娘！这儿问安了！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 只要老实公正，就可左右鄙人。到世界尽头还有多远，哥儿们？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唔，一天的路程，妞儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你肯陪我一起去吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们去那儿干吗呢，妞儿？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘿，玩板球呀。还有别的什么可玩呢？

chinese.text: 那么请听：你的表弟骑上埃米莉当初给他的一匹马，一匹没有一根白毛的黑马——有人说，这种马再好，有了这个标志，就贬低了它的身价，很多人都不肯买它；这个迷信现在倒得到了印证——阿奇特骑在这匹马上，在雅典的石头路上疾驰，那防滑尖铁不是在践踏，而是在轻掠；因为这马恨不得一步跨出一英里远，如果这样会使它的骑手高兴，并以它为荣的话。正当它这样打着拍子，在燧石大道上飞奔，仿佛按照自己铁蹄奏出的音乐舞蹈着
，这时不知是怎样一块忌妒的燧石，冷得像古老的土星

，又像它被毒火缠住，于是进出了一粒火星，或者是一片猛烈的硫黄，是不是为这个目的而存心安排的，我无从推测——那性如烈火的烈马于是大发脾气，随着性子大捣其乱，又是弹跳，又是直立；它原受过训练，动作很有调教，现在忘得一干二净；尖锐的踢马刺一扎，便像猪猡一样乱叫，不但一点不服，反而直咬嚼子；使尽劣马的一切卑鄙办法大吵大闹，硬要把稳坐在鞍上的主人颠下来。当什么办法都不管用，嚼子咬不断，肚带挣不脱，骑手两脚夹着它，似乎生长在鞍上，各种前后颠簸都无法把他连根拔除的时候——它便前蹄腾空，用后蹄直立起来，使阿奇特的两腿高过了头部，似乎靠特技悬在空中。他的胜利者的花环那时从头上落了下来；劣马立刻向后翻倒过来，它的全部重量便成了骑手的负荷。他还活着，但像一只仍然浮着、随时会在另一个浪头下面沉没的船。他很想跟你谈谈。瞧，他来了。

chinese.text: 新戏与处女何其相似：
二者只须完美无疵，
总不乏问津的主顾，
所费不赀也不在乎。
一出佳剧欣逢佳期，
亦将羞答答拜堂行礼，
战兢兢唯恐丧失童贞，
岂非闺女出嫁作新人：
经过神圣结合和初夜的张皇，
虽不似夫婿劳顿，亦不失旧日端庄。
唯愿我们的戏文也是这样，一点不假
它有一位高尚的作者，一位文雅
而饱学的诗人，无上美名早已传遍
波河与银色特伦特河之间。
本剧故事出自乔叟，名流之翘楚，
是他使之流芳直至永久。
如果它的高贵品质我们保不住，
这孩儿最初听到的就是一声嘘，
更将震撼那位老先生的遗骸，
令他在九泉之下大喊大叫，“哦快快
把那家伙的糟糠粗秕从我身上簸掉，
他败坏了我的声誉，使我的名著落到
比唱本《罗宾汉》还不如！”
我们正怕
这一点，因为要向他高攀，说句老实话，
未免太狂妄，努力一辈子也觉不够，
驽钝如我辈，在这深水中浮游，
几乎喘不过气来。恳请看官伸长
援助之手，我们必将抢风掉向
设法自救。务乞诸位垂顾
这些戏文，虽不及前辈之技艺，亦不负
两小时的苦辛。保证他的遗骸安眠，
看官满意。万一我们连一点点
清淡时刻都维持不住，那才后悔莫及：
我们亏损惨重，只好关张大吉。

chinese.text: 可怜的夫人，别再说了。我正要到他那儿去，欣然和你们一道，把这项善举进行到底，我实在再愿意不过了。我的夫君深深为你们的苦难所打动。让他考虑一下吧。我马上就说。

groups.rationale: Hippolyta consoles the queen, expresses her willingness to support the good action, says Theseus is deeply moved, and promises to speak shortly. Chinese 114 is exactly this entire reply; 115 is Second Queen rising and is excluded.

chinese.text: 那就把他们像人一样对待吧。这种人的酒渣都胜似别人的酒浆千万倍。把我们的外科大夫都请来抢救他们，放手使用我们最有效的镇痛香膏，不要吝惜；他们的生命对于我们比底比斯更有价值。本来我宁愿他们死去，也不愿他们摆脱这种狼狈状况，显得生气勃勃，健康而自由；但是，我们四万倍地愿意他们给我们当俘虏，而不是死去。快把他们从我们这里的亲切空气中抬走吧，这种空气对他们并不亲切
，像人对人一样地照顾他们吧；为了我们的缘故，还要多出一点力，因为我已经体验过种种恐怖，愤怒，朋友的吩咐，爱情的挑逗，热情奋发，情妇的虐待，对自由的向往，一阵狂热，疯癫，还设置过一个没有上列外力强制、单凭天性驱使是无法到达的目标，因为意志的软弱会压倒理智的力量
。为了我们的爱情和伟大阿波罗的慈悲
，让我们最优秀的医生提供他们最高明的医术吧。——带队进城，在那儿收拾残局，我们好在部队前面赶回雅典。

groups.rationale: Theseus orders humane treatment of the wounded cousins, values their lives above Thebes, summons the best surgeons and balms, reflects on passion surpassing natural strength, and plans to return to Athens after ordering the city. Chinese 198 covers the entire speech. Note markers and the separate flourish/exit 199 are excluded.

chinese.text: 这世界是一个迷途纵横的城市，死亡是市场让人人在此相遇。

groups.rationale: Third Queen compares the world with a city of wandering streets and death with their common marketplace. Chinese 217 is that complete couplet; the exit in 218 is separate stage material.

chinese.text: 从王国流放么？这可是我非感谢他们不可的一件恩典，一种慈悲；可是再也没有机会自由欣赏那张我愿为之一死的脸庞了——哦，这可是一桩深谋远虑的刑罚，一次难以想象的死亡！即使我又老又坏，我所有的罪过也不可能把这样一种报复揽到自己身上来。巴拉蒙！你现在可占先了；你留下来，每天早晨可以看见她那明媚的眼睛冲着你的窗口闪耀，给你注入生命力；你可以饱餐一位高贵美人的秀色，那是大自然从未超过、也永不会超过的秀色。仁慈的诸神啊！巴拉蒙是何等幸福！十有八九，他会上前跟她讲话，如果她既美丽又温柔，我知道她就属于他了；他有一条驯服风暴、并使顽石点头的舌头。不论发生什么，最糟也不过一死：我决不离开这个王国。我知道我自己不过是一堆废墟，已经无可修整。我一走，他就会得到她。我决定改头换面来完成我自己，否则结束我的命运。我会看见她，会挨近她，或者死掉：无论什么结果，我都高兴。

groups.rationale: Arcite calls exile a benefit except for losing Emilia, envies imprisoned Palamon’s daily view and persuasive tongue, resolves to stay despite death, and plans to change his appearance to be near her. Chinese 361 contains the full soliloquy and stops before the countrymen’s entrance in 362.

chinese.text: 公爵把希波吕忒给丢了；各人都走上了岔路。这是专为百花盛开的五月举办的一次隆重的庆典，为了把它办得完美无缺，雅典人才舍得花钱。哦，伊米莉娅女王，比五月还要鲜艳，比它枝头金黄蓓蕾或者草原上、花园里的涂彩花样还要芳香！真的，我们还可向任何宁芙的河岸挑战，尽管她使流水变得像花朵一样！哦，你，林子里，世界上的珍宝，你到哪儿，哪儿都有福了。唯愿我，这个可怜人，很快介入你的沉思，引起你某种纯洁的思虑！碰上这样一位女主人，可不是三倍的机缘么，真是喜出望外。告诉我吧，仅次于我的君主埃米莉的命运女神，我还可以得意到什么程度呢？她热切地关注我，让我挨近她；就在这个美好的早晨，一年最新颖的一个早晨，又送给我两匹马；这两匹骏马，就是两个国王在互相争夺王权的战场上，也会拿它们来打赌。天哪，天哪，可怜的巴拉蒙表兄，可怜的囚徒，你简直梦想不到我的幸运，才自以为你那样挨近伊米莉娅，要比我更幸福。你以为我在底比斯，虽然自由了，可是很倒楣。可你要是知道，我的女主人怎样对我轻言细语，我怎样耳听她的话语，活在她的眼睛里，哦，表兄，你又会陷入怎样一团怒火之中啊！

groups.rationale: Arcite describes the May observance, praises Emilia above spring flowers, rejoices that she notices him and gave him two horses, then imagines Palamon’s jealousy if he knew their intimacy. Chinese 441 is the full soliloquy; Palamon’s emerging from the bushes in 442 is excluded.

chinese.text: 不，请问——你说拿食物给我吃，把我养壮；可你现在去看一个太阳，太阳却能使它照到的一切变得强壮；你这不是占了我的上风吗？不过，你尽管去享用吧，我会坚持要求赔偿的。再见。

groups.rationale: Palamon points out that Arcite’s proposed food supplies strength while seeing Emilia, like the sun, gives Arcite an advantage, then promises to seek redress and says farewell. Chinese 464 has all of this; separate exits at 465 are excluded.

chinese.text: 想必到了地方。嗬，巴拉蒙表兄！

groups.rationale: Arcite thinks he is near the meeting place and calls to cousin Palamon. Chinese 471 is the complete short summons; Palamon’s emerging in 472 is a stage direction.

chinese.text: 我冷得很，星星也都出来了，小星星和所有看来像亮晶晶小纽扣似的星星。太阳已经看见了我的愚蠢。巴拉蒙！唉，别提他；他在天堂里了。我现在在哪儿？那里是大海，还有一条船。晃动得好凶啊！水底下有块礁石在盯着呢；唷，唷，它撞上它了——唷，唷，唷！撞出了一个洞，老大一个洞。他们怎样在叫喊！让船顺风漂流吧，要不你们都玩儿完。扯起一两面大横帆，抢风掉向吧，小伙子们！晚安，晚安，你们走了。我饿得很：唯愿找得到一只嫩青蛙！他会告诉我世界各地的消息。然后我要用海扇壳做成一艘大货船，先向东开，再向东北，去找小人国的国王，他算命算得准极了。我父亲明儿早上，八九不离十，就会上绞颈架了；我一句话也不会说。

groups.rationale: The Daughter’s wandering monologue describes cold and stars, imagines Palamon in heaven and a shipwreck, gives sailing orders, longs for food and a frog’s news, proposes a shell voyage to the pygmy king, then fears her father’s hanging. Chinese 518 supplies the entire monologue up to her promise not to speak. Its final singing cue is excluded.

chinese.text: 我要裁我的绿上衣，裁到膝盖上一尺，
我还要剪我的黄头发，剪到眼睛下一寸，
嗨，哝呢，哝呢，哝呢
要他给我买匹小白马，白马白马短尾巴，
让我骑着走遍天涯海角去找他。
嗨，哝呢，哝呢，哝呢。
哦，真想有一根刺，好让我像夜莺一样把胸脯扑上去
。否则我会熟睡得像一只陀螺。

groups.rationale: The Daughter sings of cutting her green coat and yellow hair, riding a white short-tailed horse across the world to find him, then wishes for a nightingale’s thorn lest she sleep. Chinese 519–525 is the complete song and 526 its spoken continuation. Blank 522, note markers and the final exit are excluded; this keeps the whole English block intact.

chinese.text: 正如饱学之士所云，这叫做端水洗屋瓦，白费力气，
吾人岂非其愚不可及也

groups.rationale: The Schoolmaster says they have washed a tile, foolishly labouring in vain. Chinese 546 gives the learned tile proverb and wasted effort; 547 continues the same speaker with the folly clause. The next labelled speaker begins at 548. Note markers are excluded.
reviewNotes: Chinese 547 has the indented block1 class but is the continuation translating the Latin/foolishness phrase, not a stage direction.

chinese.text: 乔治·阿鲁从南来，
从巴巴里的海边来呀；
他遇见打仗的勇士们，
一个，两个，三个呀。

groups.rationale: The Daughter’s first song stanza names George Alow coming from Barbary in the south and meeting gallants one, two and three. Chinese 556–559 is precisely that full stanza, under her singing label at 555; the next stanza starts at 561.
reviewNotes: English source-leading [Sings.] is preserved inside the immutable full speech block; the corresponding Chinese cue is excluded from the spoken overlay.

chinese.text: 万岁，万岁，你快乐的勇士们！
你们现在往哪儿去呀？
哦，让我跟你们做个伴
一直走到海湾去呀。

groups.rationale: The Daughter’s second stanza hails the gallants, asks their destination, and seeks their company to the sound. Chinese 561–564 is the full stanza; neither the preceding nor following stanza is consumed.

chinese.text: 有三个傻子为一只小猫头鹰
闹得不可开交：
一个说它是猫头鹰，
另一个说不像，不像，
第三个说它是只老鹰，
身上给摘掉了铃铛。

groups.rationale: The Daughter’s next song describes three fools disputing whether an owlet is an owl or a hawk with its bells removed. Chinese 566–571 gives this complete song; the labelled Third Countryman at 572 starts another turn.

chinese.text: 上场了，孩子们；
出来吧，跳起来。
奏乐。

groups.rationale: The Schoolmaster calls his children to enter and dance. Chinese 596 contains the Latin summons rendered in Chinese and the invitation to come forth and dance. The parenthetical conducting and hat-lifting actions and note reference are excluded, and the separate danced entrance in 597 is excluded.
reviewNotes: Edition variation: the Chinese turn also has the brief spoken command 奏乐。 after lifting the hat; it is retained as part of the same source-labelled utterance. English places Music. in the separate following stage block. The Chinese source marks 上场了，孩子们 in bold along with a cue, but its meaning is the translation of the spoken Latin Intrate, filii, so typography alone must not discard it.

chinese.text: 女士们，如果我们欢欢喜喜，
演个“得里”让你们满意，
又一个“得里”，再加一个“当”，
就算教师我没有出洋相。
如果我们还能让公爵高兴，
不过是小的们尽了责任，
但请赏赐一根两根树，
明年又可用作五月柱，
趁又一年还没有过完，
我们会逗大人开怀大笑，我们全戏班。

groups.rationale: After the dance, the Schoolmaster addresses the ladies and duke, hopes the merry performance pleased them, asks for one or two trees for a maypole, and promises another year’s laughter. Chinese 598–607 is this entire verse turn; the preceding dance paragraph 597 and following Theseus reply 608 are separate.

chinese.text: 愿你猎的公鹿活得长，
愿你的猎狗快又壮；
愿你宰鹿十分方便，
愿太太们都吃到鹿鞭。

groups.rationale: The Schoolmaster’s four-line hunting blessing wishes the stag to last, the hounds strength and speed, an unhindered kill, and the ladies the stag’s testicles. Chinese 614–617 through the first sentence is exactly this verse. The following royal exit inside 617 is excluded.

chinese.text: 好了，我们成功了。托每位男女神仙保佑，
你们跳得好极了，姑娘们。

groups.rationale: After the court exits, the Schoolmaster celebrates success, invokes all gods and goddesses, and praises the girls’ dancing. This is the rest of Chinese 617 beginning 好了; it follows the parenthetical exit and does not include the preceding hunting blessing or the later general exit at 618.
reviewNotes: The bold Chinese invocation 托每位男女神仙保佑 is spoken translation of Dii deæque omnes, not stage action. Note marker 57 is excluded.

chinese.text: 再见，阿奇特。

groups.rationale: Palamon says farewell to Arcite. Chinese 675 is the exact short reply; the fighting and horn interruption in 676 are excluded.

chinese.text: 好吧，我现在以对王子和朋友的礼遇接待你们。你们回来的时候，谁赢了我就为他在这儿安家；谁输了，我也会在他的棺前哭一场。

groups.rationale: Theseus offers princely and friendly hospitality, promises a home for the eventual victor, and tears at the loser’s bier. Chinese 742 is the complete final speech; the scene-clearing exit at 743 is excluded.

chinese.text: 朝林子开去，船主。抢风前进！
当月神以其借来的光……

groups.rationale: The Daughter orders the imagined ship toward the wood and to tack, then starts the song about Cynthia’s borrowed light. Chinese 831 contains the nautical commands and 832 the same truncated song opening. The singing cue and following exeunt are excluded; the English inline [Sings.] and &c. remain unchanged.

chinese.text: 我们的星辰必将以新火而闪耀。否则今天就得熄灭。我们的主题就是爱情，如果爱情女神许可，她还将给我们以胜利。那么，把你们的精神和我的精神融合起来，你们高尚的慷慨行为使你们为我的目标甘冒个人的危险。让我们把我们的行动交托给维纳斯女神吧，祈求她的威灵保佑我们这一方。

groups.rationale: Palamon tells his knights their stars must shine or expire, identifies love as their cause, asks them to unite their spirits with his, and commends their venture to Venus. This is the opening spoken passage of Chinese 912, ending immediately before the kneeling stage direction.

chinese.text: 向你欢呼，至高无上的神秘女王

！你有力量使最凶悍的暴君解除愤怒，甚至哭得像一名少女；你有能力即令匆匆一瞥而使马尔斯的战鼓喑哑，使准备战斗的号召变为悄声低语；你能使一个瘸子挥舞拐杖，比医神阿波罗更快地把他治愈；你可以迫使国王向他的子民俯首称臣，诱导昏庸老朽们翩翩起舞；秃顶的单身汉，青年时期像调皮的儿童穿过篝火，安全地跳过了你的火焰，到他七十岁你仍能抓住他，使他不顾沙哑喉咙惹人嘲笑，滥唱青年人的恋歌。有什么神灵般的力量是你没有力量制服的呢？你给日神福玻斯添加的火焰比他自己的更其炽热；天火烤焦了他凡间的儿子，你的火却烤焦了他。
有人说，狩猎女神泪流满面，浑身冰凉，开始把她的神弓扔掉，长吁短叹。

我是你的立誓效忠的士兵，请让我蒙受你的恩典吧，你的驾轭虽比铅块还重，比荨麻还刺人，我肩负起它来，仿佛戴上了一圈玫瑰花。我从未以污秽的语言违抗过你的法律，从未泄露过秘密，因为我什么秘密也不知道；即使知道一切秘密，我也不会泄露。我从未诱骗过别人的妻子，也不会阅读放荡才子们毁谤性的黄色作品。我从未在盛宴上设法暴露一位美妇的隐私，听见一些假笑的先生说这些话，我都脸红。对于自夸艳福的登徒子们，我从来没有好颜色，总是热辣辣地质问他们有没有母亲；我是有母亲的，她是一个女人，他们玷污的正是女人。我对他们说，我认识一个八十老翁，他娶了一个十四岁的少女做新娘——是你的力量把生命注入了尘土。老年常犯的痉挛使他的两腿由直变弯，痛风使他的手指结成硬块，磨人的抽搐几乎把球状的眼睛从眼眶内抽了出来，看来他身上过去的生命都变成了折磨。可这副骷髅却使那个年轻漂亮的媳妇为他生了一个儿子，我相信这孩子是他的，因为她起誓是他的，谁会不相信她呢？总而言之，对那些吹嘘自己淫荡行为的家伙，我抵触；对那些只吹而未干过的，我蔑视；对那些想干而不能的，我高兴。是的，我不欢喜以最下流方式传播别人阴私的人，也不欢喜以最放肆的语言张扬隐秘的人。我就是这样一个人，我可以起誓，任何情人都不会叹息得比我更真诚。哦，最温柔最亲切的女神，请保佑我在这场斗争中获得胜利吧，这才是纯真爱情应得的奖赏，请将表明你伟大恩惠的信物赐给我吧。

groups.rationale: Palamon’s complete prayer hails Venus’s power over tyrants, war, infirmity, old age and gods, vows his own truthful chastity and rejection of boasts about sexual conquests, tells of the old man’s child, and asks victory and a sign. The corresponding continuous prayer in Chinese 912 begins 向你欢呼 and ends before the music/doves sign. Note references are excluded without splitting the English speech.

chinese.text: 哦，你统治着从十一岁到九十岁的凡人的情怀，你的猎场就是这个世界，我们这些群氓就是你的猎物。我谨向你致谢，为了这件美妙的信物，它正放在我纯洁真诚的心头，保证能武装我的躯体从事这场斗争。
让我们起立，向女神鞠躬。

groups.rationale: Palamon thanks the goddess who rules mortals from eleven to ninety for the sign, says it reassures his innocent heart and arms him, and asks his knights to rise and bow. Chinese 912 after the music/dove cue and before the bow action is the full response. The inline address to the knights is excluded.

chinese.text: 时间到了。

groups.rationale: Palamon says the time has come. Chinese 912 has precisely 时间到了。 after the bow and before the exit. No part of Emilia’s separate entrance in 913 belongs to him.

chinese.text: 请安吧，你的情郎到了。

groups.rationale: The Jailer tells his daughter to curtsy because her lover is coming. Chinese 965 is the entire line; Wooer’s advance in 966 is separate stage action.

chinese.text: 我们会有许多孩子。
天哪，你长得好壮啊！希望我的巴拉蒙也会长，长得漂漂亮亮，现在他自由了。唉，可怜的娃儿，他吃得粗，住得坏，身子给整垮了，可我要亲他，把他亲得再壮实起来。

groups.rationale: The Daughter anticipates many children, admires the Doctor’s growth, hopes freed Palamon will grow too, recalls his poor diet and lodging, and promises to kiss him well. Chinese 990 contains the whole turn. Her address-to-Doctor cue and the Messenger entrance at 991 are excluded.
reviewNotes: English inline [To Doctor.] remains verbatim inside the immutable English block.

chinese.text: 到了。你在那儿还有任务呢。

groups.rationale: The Messenger confirms the men are at the lists and reminds the Jailer that he has a duty there too. Chinese 994 says both things explicitly, between the Jailer’s question in 993 and promise to come in 995; this is a genuine recoverable mapping gap, not a source omission.

chinese.text: 再见，妹妹，我大概要比你略早一点认识你的丈夫。我祈祷众神从这两个中间为你选择他们认为最好的一个。

groups.rationale: Hippolyta bids her sister farewell, expects to know her husband slightly earlier than she does, and asks the gods to choose the better man. Chinese 1028 is the complete speech; the exit and Emilia’s portraits in 1029 are stage action.

chinese.text: 那么是他赢了。一向可能是——他总显得温文尔雅而又胜券在握，无疑是男人中的魁首。请你快去看看，告诉我情况怎样了。

groups.rationale: Emilia concludes Palamon has won, recalls his grace and promise of success, calls him the finest man, and asks the servant to run and report. Chinese 1032 contains the full turn. The shout and cornets at 1033 are not her speech.

chinese.text: 请你注意喊声；把两只耳朵竖起来听。

groups.rationale: Emilia asks the servant to attend closely to the cry with both ears. Chinese 1040 is the exact full request; the offstage cry and cornets in 1041 are excluded.

chinese.text: 我们会高高兴兴跟上来的。

groups.rationale: Second and Third Knights jointly promise to follow cheerfully. The Chinese joint speaker label 骑士乙和丙 at 1068 confirms the correspondence. The offstage interruption at 1069 is excluded.

chinese.text: 起身吧，高尚的先生，请听最甜美也最辛酸的消息。

groups.rationale: Pirithous tells Palamon to rise and hear tidings both sweet and bitter. Chinese 1075 is the complete summons. Palamon’s rising in 1076 is a separate stage action.

chinese.text: 命运从没玩过一场更不可捉摸的游戏。被征服者凯旋了，胜利者失败了；但是，在进程中，众神都非常公正。巴拉蒙，你的表弟已经承认，你对这位小姐的确拥有权利，因为是你先看见她，并且当即宣布了你的爱慕。他把她作为你的被偷走的珍宝物归原主，希望你的心灵对他宽恕，送他离开人世。众神从我手中夺走了我的审判职能，他们自己变成了判决执行者。把你的小姐带走吧；把陪伴你的骑士们从断头架上叫回来，我要和他们交朋友。这一两天让我们面带悲戚，为阿奇特的葬礼举行感恩祷告；葬礼完毕，我们都要装出新郎的面容，和巴拉蒙一起微笑；仅仅一小时以前，我曾经深深为他难过，同样为阿奇特高兴，现在我为他而高兴，却为阿奇特难过了。啊，你们上天的魔法师们，你们究竟要把我们变成什么东西呢！我们为我们缺少的一切欢笑，为我们拥有的一切悲伤，我们在某种意义上仍然是孩子。让我们为现存的一切感恩戴德，那些我们无从探究的事物也不再同你们争辩了。让我们散去，随遇而安，因时制宜吧。

groups.rationale: Theseus concludes that fortune has reversed winner and loser while the gods remained just, confirms Palamon’s prior right to Emilia, releases his knights, calls for Arcite’s funeral before wedding joy, and reflects on human childishness before departure. Chinese 1088 contains exactly the entire final speech. The following flourish/exit 1089 and independent epilogue 1090–1111 belong to neither Theseus nor this speech.
reviewNotes: The raw candidate wrongly continued into the separate epilogue. No epilogue heading, entrance, speaker label, verse or exit is consumed. The English epilogue is independently retained as source-classified text at epilogue:2, a separate source-classified text block, reviewed independently as an additional epilogue group.

chinese.text: 现在想问一问看官，这出戏文如何，
在下我像小学生一样，实在不好说；
为此不胜惶惑。且请诸位稍安毋躁，
让我往池座瞧瞧。怎么竟没人微笑？
看来这就难办。总该有人欣赏台上
某个年少靓女，何妨起身亮一亮相——
怪哉又没有人——如果哪一位愿意，
尽可装模作样大喝倒彩，直至封闭
我们的财源。看来想拦你也拦不成。
让最坏下场来临吧！阁下是否称心？
但请不要误会——我不会自以为是——
没有理由冒失。如果我们讲的故事，
虽然拿不出手，却多少令诸位满意
（因为它本打算实现这正当的目的）
我们也就了却心愿；敢说不久你们

groups.rationale: The independent Epilogue speaker anxiously asks how the audience liked the play, looks for smiles, challenges an admirer of a pretty girl to hiss and destroy the market, then hopes the tale has pleased, promises better plays, offers the company’s service and says good night. Chinese 1093–1110 follows the whole closing address, under the distinct Epilogue speaker label at 1092. The heading, entrance and exit at 1090–1092 and 1111 are separate source material.
reviewNotes: This is one additional whole English source-classified text block, not part of the original 34 missing speech blocks. Preserve its kind and its internal EPILOGUE label verbatim. Chinese 1106 is a parenthetical spoken verse meaning that the play was meant to please, corresponding to For to that honest purpose it was meant ye; it is not a stage cue and must be retained. The Chinese epilogue remains separate from Theseus’s last speech.
